text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —The time has come.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Curtain, rise! What unfolds hereafter is
a war chronicle of ruin and frenzy, waged with my very existence on the line!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
O World! O Observers! Open your eyes and behold!!
With my brilliance, witness this fleeting yet tempestuous myth
that shall guide every future into utter chaos!!

text_block_list.name: Sound of Lightning
text_block_list.text: (KRA-BOOOOOOOM!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Heh! Yes, fear it! Tremble!! But it is already too late! The curtain has just risen!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: With the immortal value of "myself", I shall utterly annihilate every single principle of this world!! No one can stop me now!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Fufufu...! Ahaha————

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha!!
BWAHAHAHAHAHA!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (————*CRACK-CRACK-CRACK-CRUNCHHH!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Today, the challenge of taking on
the Twinkle Series with Tanino Gimlet begins!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Clearing up as if yesterday's storm were all a lie,
my heart naturally begins to fire up
for the days ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To prepare for today's training with Tanino Gimlet,
I went to check the track conditions, but then—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Bwahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Fence, can you feel it...?! Your sturdiness
is rising, just like the shield of a guardian goddess!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I do not destroy in vain!
By breaking and recreating,
I shall forever blaze new trails...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Standing before a pile of shattered fences that she had clearly kicked down, Tanino Gimlet was spouting her usual grandiloquence.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Naturally, it brings rebirth.
With hammerwork worthy of the god of smithing himself.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It seems Tanino Gimlet broke the fence again
during yesterday's storm...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "And then, repairing it yourself as usual, all alone like this—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Tsk, tsk, tsk...! Say no more.
This is a symbol of my dialogue with the world.
Its karma, too, belongs to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I still wonder why the fence along the track was destroyed
on that stormy day, but if I'm to work hard as her Trainer
starting today—"
choice_data_list: I'll help fix the fence too
I'll help fix the fence too

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to lend a hand here, both to spend time
with Tanino Gimlet and to get to know her better.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, fascinating.
Let us see what kind of karma those innocent hands, unacquainted with destruction, shall wield.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "...Understood. In that case, I shall leave the rest to you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However, since there are quite a lot of them,
it might be a bit of a challenge, but――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Tanino Gimlet and I carefully repaired the fence together, and by the time we finished, the sun had already begun to set...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since training seemed difficult under these circumstances,
I was about to suggest holding a meeting in the Trainer's Office instead, when—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before I realized it, Tanino Gimlet was gone...!
She was right here with me just a moment ago, but—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wondered if you might have gone to the Trainer's Room first
and came to check, but nobody was here. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Tonight, beneath the great tree where past and future intersect."
A note with these words lay on the desk.
...Nine times out of ten, it's Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Ho.
To show up already... you are sooner than I anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
How did things end up like this...?
Why don't you let me hear your deduction?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Tanino Gimlet had previously referred to this place as 'Yggdrasil.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of all the places I knew that were connected to her,
this was the only one that brought to mind the words 'Great Tree.'

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. Excellent, truly...!
The "speed" with which you deduced this place from memory, the "strength" of that intuition! Just as I expected of you...!
choice_data_list: But why would you pull a stunt like this?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
――I know full well.
You came intending to discuss the future with me, didn't you?
Yet a mere corner of the academy lacks romance, wouldn't you say...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
One cannot properly drink without the right mood—
which is why I have prepared everything like so.
...Shall we talk, then?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying that, Tanino Gimlet poured a brightly colored mocktail into a glass and offered it to me...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now then—
First of all, what would you ask of me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems she intends to hold the meeting right here. Now that she's set this up, I can't just turn her down.
choice_data_list: ...I want to reaffirm what you're aiming for.
...I'd like to confirm what you're aiming for once more.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"What I aim for...
In other words, the end of my journey. That is, of course—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Etching my mark into the world with sheer “speed” and “strength.”
A dazzling destruction piercing through all of past and future...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Proof of existence forged by a blinding flash of brilliance!
That is the grand script I have conceived!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: You know what needs to be done for that, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Glory in the Twinkle Series.
One of its grandest stages is known as the 'Classic Triple Crown.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It is a contest for supremacy across three races—the Satsuki Sho, Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), and Kikuka Sho—open only to Classic-class Umamusume, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Especially in the Classic year, this "route" serves as
a fundamental baseline—a core pillar—for both
the runners and the spectators alike.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the "Classic Triple Crown route" serving as the axis,
a race rotation concept approached from a new angle emerged—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—That is the 'MC Rotation.'
It's been gaining traction in recent years,
and is precisely what Tanino Gimlet seeks to conquer.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This rotation means running back-to-back in the 1600m GⅠ NHK Mile Cup
and the 2400m GⅠ Japanese Derby—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At its core lies the philosophy of proving natural miler speed at 1,600m,
and overall middle-distance strength at 2,400m.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "To run well and complete the MC Rotation would be a monumental feat that proudly proves the sheer brilliance of that Umamusume's innate talent...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, that is easier said than done. Pulling off this rotation
comes with many difficulties. Inherent factors like distance
aptitude aside, the greatest challenge of all is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The short span of time between the two races: the NHK Mile Cup and the Japanese Derby."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It had to be said: that was a brutally tight schedule for a Classic-class Umamusume whose body had not yet fully matured.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the worst-case scenario, she risks suffering
an injury that could be fatal to her racing career—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Indeed. I am well aware of how harsh it is.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: However! Precisely because it is harsh, it holds value! There is frenzy!! There is intoxication!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Not in sunlit tranquility,
but amidst the harshness of looming dark clouds—
that is where my brilliance shall shine most vividly!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Besides, you received a revelation
that "I can achieve it,"
and that is why you stand here now, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The fierce talent Tanino Gimlet displayed that day. And the intense, hardworking spirit hidden within that backed it up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I can still vividly recall the sensation that made my entire being throb with excitement. Yes, ever since that moment, I've been utterly intoxicated by her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "By completing the MC Rotation, Tanino Gimlet will surely become a presence whose talent is praised for generations to come."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her Trainer, I want to see it too—
Tanino Gimlet fulfilling her dream
and leaving an unforgettable mark on the world...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
Then swear it once more, right here and now!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I shall unfailingly make my ideals a promise to the world.
With 'swiftness' and 'strength', I will shatter all common sense!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And as my Trainer, you will do everything in your
power to ensure this scenario plays out without fail.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The price is... the supreme intoxication.
I shall etch a frenzy that lasts for all eternity into your very soul...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... What a fine response—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"—Then, let us raise a toast.
To the beginning of our ruinous journey."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shared a mocktail toast with Tanino Gimlet.
The clink of our glasses resounding against each other
felt somewhat comforting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, the curtain rose
on the days of challenging the odds with Tanino Gimlet...!
